clips.title: The story
paras: Across Mulgore’s central plains, tauren hunters gather Cougar Claws for a cleansing ritual. The claws come from flatland cougars, among the grasslands’ apex hunters.

Flatland cougars rank among the apex hunters of Mulgore’s grasslands, stalking prey by instinct. For the tauren, taking their claws is neither casual slaughter nor trophy hunting; it gathers the beast’s natural spirit. When goblin operations defile the plains’ ancestral waters, Mull Thunderhorn asks young hunters to collect Cougar Claws alongside prairie stalker claws. The tauren believe native beasts’ pure predatory instincts can be woven into a ritual totem. They mean to use it to scour unnatural toxins and foul sorcery from the poisoned Thunderhorn Water Well.
